files.patch: @@ -929,10 +929,4 @@ - When preview features are enabled, JVMTI may observe both identity and value objects. - JVMTI treats both kinds of objects in the same manner as JNI. Agents can use the JNI - HasIdentity - function to determine whether a JNI object reference denotes an object with identity. - JNI functions whose semantics depend on identity, including - IsSameObject - and - NewWeakGlobalRef, - specify the JNI behavior for value objects. Any additional JVMTI-specific behavior - is specified by the affected JVMTI functions or events. + If preview features are enabled then some Java objects will have identity and others + (instances of value classes) will not. makes no distinction between these cases + in general, but some specific functions will behave differently if invoked upon + a Java object that does not have identity.
